        16                  THE PRESIDENT:    Senator Duane, to

        17       explain your vote.

        18                  SENATOR DUANE:    Thank you, Madam

        19       President.

        20                  I would be remiss if I didn't point

        21       out, while this is an admirable piece of

        22       legislation coming before us today, that it

        23       does point to the issue that many of those who

        24       served in our armed forces either become

        25       disabled as a result of their service or that


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        3302



         1       this is something that happens later on in

         2       life.

         3                  And one of the disabilities that we

         4       know happens to people, particularly if they

         5       have served in combat, is that they get

         6       posttraumatic syndrome.  And whether you are

         7       in the military or you are a veteran of the

         8       military, chances are in that case you're

         9       entitled to get psychological counseling as a

        10       result of your veterans benefits.

        11                  But unfortunately, New Yorkers who

        12       have not been veterans and who do not have

        13       coverage for their mental health care if they

        14       have been traumatized don't get the

        15       counselling that they need.

        16                  And that's why we need Timothy's

        17       Law, so that every New Yorker and every family

        18       in New York is entitled to parity for their

        19       mental health services.

        20                  And this is the last time that we

        21       will be together this month, and yet still

        22       Timothy's Law has not come to the floor of the

        23       Senate for at least a debate.  And this is

        24       just plain wrong for the families of New York

        25       State.


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        3303



         1                  It behooves us to make sure that

         2       Timothy's Law come to the floor of the Senate

         3       as soon as we get back in the month of June.

         4                  So, Madam President, I'll be voting

         5       yes on this, but I also hope that we use the

         6       time that we have off to figure out a way to

         7       get a good healthy debate on Timothy's Law to

         8       the floor of the Senate.

         9                  Thank you, Madam President.

        12       resolution.
